tools.name: energy-intelligence_current
tools.description: Retrieve current GB electricity carbon intensity from the Carbon Intensity API. Supports optional regional filtering. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/current. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_historical
tools.description: Retrieve historical or forecast carbon intensity data for a specific time period from the Carbon Intensity API. Supports regional filtering. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/historical. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_regional
tools.description: Retrieve carbon intensity data for all GB regions or a specific region from the Carbon Intensity API. Includes generation mix information. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/regional. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_generation-mix
tools.description: Retrieve electricity generation mix data showing fuel type proportions from the Carbon Intensity API. Supports regional and time-based filtering. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/generation-mix. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_forecast
tools.description: Retrieve forecast carbon intensity data from the Carbon Intensity API. Supports regional filtering. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/forecast. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_regions
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for all GB regions supported by the Carbon Intensity API including region IDs and names. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/regions. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: energy-intelligence_report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive energy intelligence report combining current intensity, regional data, and generation mix from the Carbon Intensity API. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/energy-intelligence/report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "energy-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions · Public sink: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions, energy-intelligence_report · Destructive: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions, energy-intelligence_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions · Public sink: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions, energy-intelligence_report · Destructive: energy-intelligence_current, energy-intelligence_historical, energy-intelligence_regional, energy-intelligence_generation-mix, energy-intelligence_forecast, energy-intelligence_regions, energy-intelligence_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
